title: Still in the Doorway
description: It has been standing there since you entered the hall. You are certain of this, though you cannot account for why you only notice it now. It is shaped like a person - coat, hands, the suggestion of shoulders - but where a face should be there is only smooth, pale nothing. It does not move. It does not need to. You feel the pressure of its attention like a hand pressing against the inside of your skull.

standard_attack.telegraph: The Threshold Figure turns its blank face toward you, and the silence in the room becomes absolute.

special_attacks.telegraph: The Threshold Figure has not moved, and yet somehow it is closer - close enough that you can see your own reflection warped across the smooth absence where its face should be.
The silence fractures. You hear your own name spoken in a voice you haven't heard since childhood, and it is coming from the place where its mouth should be.

pre_combat_narrative: It takes one step forward. The floor does not creak beneath it.

visual.alt_text: A featureless human figure in a dark coat, standing motionless in a tall doorway at the far end of a shadowed hall. No face. Hands at its sides.
